GeneratedBy.Name: Authors' processing (codes/parser + signal_quality_classifier)
GeneratedBy.Description: ISIS MER .dat files (int16, 20 kHz; not released) decoded, overflow-corrected, band-passed 500-5000 Hz (4th-order Butterworth, causal lfilter) and clipped to +-500 instrument units; a Random Forest signal-quality classifier on 0.5 s windows then kept, per recording, the longest continuous fragment with >= 3 consecutive 'Neuronal activity' windows (>= 1.5 s) or else the longest artefact-free fragment >= 2 s; an electrophysiologist annotated 29 excerpts (striatum/putamen, GPe, GPi).

Code in code/.

readme_content: [![DOI](https://img.shields.io/badge/DOI-10.82901%2Fnemar.nm000453-blue)](https://doi.org/10.82901/nemar.nm000453) # DBS microelectrode recordings, University Clinical Centre Gdańsk (Osowska, Szymański, Libionka 2026) - DERIVATIVE Intraoperative microelectrode recordings (MER) from 132 patients undergoing deep brain stimulation (DBS) surgery at the University Clinical Centre in Gdańsk, Poland (Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, dystonia, tremor/other movement disorders, epilepsy; awake surgery under local anaesthesia). Up to five parallel microelectrodes (Ben-gun: central, anterior, posterior, medial, lateral; inomed ISIS MER system, MicroMacro electrodes) were advanced towards the target, recording at successive depths relative to the MRI-planned target (typically from -10 mm; 0 mm = target). Scalp reference, chest ground. ## THIS IS A DERIVATIVE DATASET of short, filtered, classifier-selected segments - The original surgical recordings (ISIS .dat files, int16, 20 kHz) were NOT released by the authors. - Every run is ONE SHORT SEGMENT, not a continuous recording: from each depth recording the authors' Random Forest signal-quality classifier (0.5 s windows: neuronal activity / background / artifact) kept only the longest continuous fragment with >= 3 consecutive 'neuronal activity' windows, or else the longest artefact-free fragment of >= 2 s. Here: median 10.00 s, range 1.54-143.41 s; 22.43 h in 6646 runs. RecordingType is 'epoched' (one epoch per run). `source_time_start_s` (scans.tsv) is the offset of the kept segment within the unreleased site recording.
